subject: Launchpad Accelerator — promotional allocation for Spring 2027 cohort
messages:
From: Rina Patel <rina@launchpadaccelerator.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Accelerator Ops <accelerator-ops@launchpadaccelerator.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launchpad Spring 2027 — request for promotional allocation

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you’re well — we’re kicking off the application period for our Spring 2027 Launchpad cohort (starts May). We’ve had strong interest from early-stage teams building generative AI and infra tooling — several asked specifically about Redwood when evaluating providers.

Would Redwood be open to providing partner-sourced promotional credits for the cohort? High-level ask: $10k credits per startup for up to 10 startups (total $100k) OR a conservative alternative of $5k–6k per startup for more of a pilot (we’re flexible).

How we’ll use it:
- Attribution via a promo code for each accepted startup
- Co-marketing mention in our demo day materials and partner page
- A short survey at 60 days to capture usage/feedback

Attachments: Launchpad_Program_Deck.pdf (program overview)

If you can share Redwood’s standard partner promo terms and a timeline for sign-off, we’ll finalize the cohort roster and provide billing contacts.

Thanks — would love to jump on a 20-min call if easier.

Best,
Rina Patel
Head of Partnerships | Launchpad Accelerator
rina@launchpadaccelerator.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Rina Patel <rina@launchpadaccelerator.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Accelerator Ops <accelerator-ops@launchpadaccelerator.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launchpad Spring 2027 — request for promotional allocation

Hi Rina — thanks for the note and the deck, exciting cohort. CC’ing Marissa (partner programs) to scope options.

A few quick clarifying Qs so we can route this internally:
- Confirm number of unique startups that would receive a code and approximate ARR stage (pre-seed / seed / series A).
- Are credits intended for product eval only (no commercial resale)?
- Any geographic constraints (US-only vs global)?
- Do you require invoices / PO or is a partner addendum + code sufficient?

We typically provide promo allocations with these guardrails: per-startup cap, expiration window (90–180 days), attribution code, and a simple partner addendum. I’ll defer to Marissa on dollar bands and approval flow, but happy to run a 20-min call next week if helpful.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
(650) 555-0122
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Rina Patel <rina@launchpadaccelerator.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launchpad Spring 2027 — request for promotional allocation

Thanks Rina — deck looked great. Quick internal note to Vanessa/Ben: I reviewed this with Partner Programs and Finance; we can support a pilot allocation for Launchpad but with a reduced band to manage risk and attribution.

Proposed pilot offer to present to Launchpad:
- $6,000 Redwood credits per startup, up to 10 startups (total allocation $60,000)
- Credits expire in 6 months from issuance
- Attribution via unique promo codes tied to the Launchpad program
- Accelerator must sign a short partner addendum (I’ve attached a draft) and agree to a usage feedback survey at 60 days

Conditions: no resale, no transfer; Redwood reserves the right to revoke codes for abuse. Finance needs a signed addendum or PO for audit trail. I’ve attached partner_addendum_draft_v2.pdf for legal/ops review.

Next steps for Rina: if that band works, confirm cohort size and we’ll route legal + finance for final signoff and generate promo codes.

Attachments: partner_addendum_draft_v2.pdf

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Rina Patel <rina@launchpadaccelerator.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launchpad Spring 2027 — request for promotional allocation

Marissa — thanks, that structure sounds reasonable and aligns with conversations we had internally. We can commit to up to 10 startups at the $6k level.

Two asks before we sign the addendum:
1) Can Redwood extend the expiration window to 90 days after issuance (we’d like some runway for teams to onboard) — otherwise 6 months is fine if that’s preferable for you.
2) We’ll need a 90-day trial extension option on top of credits for teams that request more time to evaluate (not all will need it, but a few may). Is that something you can add as an optional clause?

I’ve attached the cohort roster (cohort_roster.csv) with company names and stage. Please let us know if you need company-specific exceptions.

Happy to sign the addendum once we align on the expiry/extension language.

Best,
Rina
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rina Patel <rina@launchpadaccelerator.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launchpad Spring 2027 — request for promotional allocation

Quick internal update (looping Rina on final mechanics):

Approved by Partner Programs: $6k x up to 10 startups = $60k total allocation.
Approved conditional on: signed partner addendum (attached) OR a PO from Launchpad; expiry window set to 6 months but we’ll allow 1x 90-day trial extension per team on a case-by-case basis (product will implement an ‘extension’ flag for codes).

Action items:
- Marissa: finalize addendum language with Legal to include the optional 90-day extension clause and send to Rina for signature (target: EOD Wed).
- Ben (Finance): please create the accounting allocation record and note deal id HUB-89234.
- Product: create promo code namespace LAUNCHPAD-SP24-60K with per-code cap $6,000 and expiration logic; see promo_code_spec.md attached.

Rina — once addendum is signed we’ll issue the code set. Welcome to a short joint blog post after demo day — we’ll coordinate later.

Thanks all —
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
(650) 555-0122
